handoff: Four ranked trade-mechanics proposals, mechanics only. Waiting for owner answers; nothing approved or built.

proposals.title: Saturation: selling pushes the price down, then it recovers
proposals.problem: Same price at any volume makes the best lane permanent and extra ships a pure multiplier.
questions: Does saturation also apply to buy prices?

proposals.title: Delivery contracts: a one-off order with a deadline and a premium
proposals.problem: Every cycle is the same decision; nothing asks for a specific delivery.
questions: Replace some events or sit alongside them?

proposals.title: Sell floor: a Sell order waits for a price you set
proposals.problem: Idle stock exists but price never matters, so there is no reason to hold it.

proposals.title: Backhaul: two opposite routes on one pair share trip cost
proposals.problem: Routes are one-way with an empty return, so no trade circuit forms.
questions: One ship or two per circuit?
